prompt: Our ML research team's knowledge base is completely disorganized and I need you to set it up properly using the nb tool installed on this machine. There's a detailed specification in /workspace/task_specification.txt describing exactly what notebooks, notes, todos, and bookmarks need to be created. Please follow every step in that file carefully — including editing note contents in the specific ways described (some should have new content appended, some should be fully replaced), marking the right action item as completed, and finally creating a git checkpoint in the ml-research notebook with the exact message: 'Reorganized ML research knowledge base - initial snapshot'. When you're done, write a summary of everything you did to /workspace/kb_reorganization_summary.txt, including the notebook names, note/todo IDs, what the mlops tag search returned, and confirmation the checkpoint was created.
